day.headline: A Dog day — Tiger and Horse are in step.

reasons: Tiger and Dog share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You've watched that view long enough. Go be outside in it.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an ordinary day you would repeat
signs.message: Nothing special about today. Notice why you'd take it again.

reasons: Dog's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the market stall you always pass
signs.message: That stall you keep walking past. Stop today, buy something.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Dinner's done. Loop the block before you sit down.

reasons: Horse and Dog share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the drawer that will not shut
signs.message: Pull everything out of it, wedge fixed, it shuts. Now.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the trip talked about for a year
signs.message: You've discussed that trip for a year. Pick the dates today.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a package waiting to go back
signs.message: Tape the box, print the label, done before lunch.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the hour you cannot account for
signs.message: An hour gone somewhere. Round it off, move to the next.

reasons: Rabbit pairs with Dog — a harmonious day
signs.message: That hour vanishes daily. Let it vanish, don't investigate.

reasons: Dragon opposes Dog — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the last day of a habit
signs.message: Last day of the streak. Let it end quietly, no post-mortem.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a mood that arrived without warning
signs.message: A mood showed up uninvited. Let it sit, don't host it.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Dog — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Refreshing won't change it. Close the tab, do something physical.
